endpoints.payload: (event, data) => { if (event.ports && event.ports.length > 0) { window.postMessage({ type: "AUDIO_PORT_RESPONSE", targetId: data?.targetId }, "*", [event.ports[0]]) } }
endpoints.expression: ipcRenderer.on("AUDIO_PORT", (event, data) => { if (event.ports && event.ports.length > 0) { window.postMessage({ type: "AUDIO_PORT_RESPONSE", targetId: data?.targetId }, "*", [event.ports[0]]) } })
